bio.text: Maggy Krell, a Democrat, represents the 6th Assembly District, which covers part of Sacramento County, in the California State Assembly.
Her official website says Krell worked as a deputy attorney general, as chief legal counsel for Planned Parenthood, and as a pro bono lawyer along the border.
